# Ying Wen Full LLM Context

> Expanded context for LLMs, agents, and research assistants reading yingwen.io. Use /llms.txt for the shorter entry point.

Content last updated: 2026-09-06

## Identity
- Name: Ying Wen
- Chinese name: 温颖
- Current role: Tenure-Track Associate Professor, School of Artificial Intelligence, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
- Additional role: Mentor, Shanghai Innovation Institute
- Email: ying.wen@sjtu.edu.cn
- Website: https://yingwen.io/
- Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=_A1CxG8AAAAJ
- GitHub: https://github.com/ying-wen

## Publications by topic
- [Large language models & reasoning](https://yingwen.io/en/research/llms/): Language model reasoning, search, process reward models, alignment, and evaluation.
- [LLM agents](https://yingwen.io/en/research/llm-agents/): Tool use, multi-turn decision-making, agent memory, protocols, and collaboration.
- [Reinforcement learning](https://yingwen.io/en/research/reinforcement-learning/): Policy optimization, credit assignment, offline learning, decision models, and training systems.
- [Multi-agent games & open-ended learning](https://yingwen.io/en/research/multi-agent/): Multi-agent cooperation and competition, game theory, population diversity, auto-curricula, and zero-shot coordination.
- [Embodied AI & robot learning](https://yingwen.io/en/research/embodied-ai/): Robot manipulation, humanoid interaction, adaptive robot teams, autonomous driving, and embodied evaluation.
- [Machine learning & applications](https://yingwen.io/en/research/machine-learning/): Representation learning, speech synthesis, recommendation, scientific data extraction, and intelligent communications.

## Academic Service
- DAI 2026 Program Committee Co-Chair. The DAI 2026 theme is "Agentic AI Goes Live — Science, Systems, and Societies."
